clue.text: Country's cries of woe being heard

indicators.note: being heard means the word for the cries is taken as it sounds when spoken

parts.note: wails are long cries of grief

explanation.surface: A nation's laments are finally getting a hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: Wales is a nation of the United Kingdom.

clue.text: Someone people can thank when they have time on their hands?

definitions.text: Someone people can thank when they have time on their hands?

parts.words: Someone people can thank when they have time on their hands?
parts.note: time on your hands usually means idleness, but here it is a wristwatch strapped on

explanation.surface: Who should the idle be grateful to?
explanation.definitionFit: A horologist builds the timepieces people wear on their wrists.

clue.text: Explosive men laid wickedly across middle of country

indicators.note: across means the scrambled letters stretch over the central letter
wickedly signals the letters of the two words are scrambled
the middle of the word country is its central letter

explanation.surface: Evil men plant explosives in the heart of the land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wickedly' rearranges MEN LAID to LADMINE; 'across' sets it round N, the middle letter of 'country'.
explanation.definitionFit: A landmine is a buried bomb set off by pressure.

clue.text: Us city is organised, not run badly

indicators.note: badly signals the remaining letters are jumbled
not means the letter for run is left out

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: An American city is poorly managed but not chaotic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' drops R from ORGANISED, leaving OGANISED; 'badly' rearranges that.
explanation.definitionFit: San Diego is a large Californian city in the United States.

clue.text: Secretary allowed to gather speed producing little book

indicators.note: to gather means the first pair of pieces collects the speed piece inside them

parts.note: PA is a personal assistant, a secretary
let means allowed
mph, miles per hour, is a measure of speed

explanation.surface: A secretary is permitted to hurry along a small publication.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to gather' means the secretary and the permission together take the speed between them, so the speed lands after the secretary and before the permission.
explanation.definitionFit: A pamphlet is a short booklet with a paper cover.

clue.text: Hands over money in the French country

explanation.surface: Someone pays up in France.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is settling a debt; the other is French for land or nation.

clue.text: Dad has endless frolic in wood

parts.note: pop is a word for dad

indicators.note: endless means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: a lark is a frolic or prank

explanation.surface: Father is having a romp among the trees.
explanation.definitionFit: Poplar is the timber of a fast-growing tree.

clue.text: Misleading statement about guerrilla being seen in tree

indicators.note: about means the lie goes round the guerrilla

parts.note: a lie is a misleading statement
Che Guevara was a famous guerrilla leader

explanation.surface: A false report of a rebel spotted in the branches.
explanation.definitionFit: The lychee is an Asian fruit tree, lichee being a variant spelling.

clue.text: Players given light refreshment before start of match

indicators.note: before places the refreshment ahead of the next piece

parts.note: tea is a light refreshment

indicators.note: the start of the word match is its opening letter

explanation.surface: The side gets a cuppa before kick-off.
explanation.definitionFit: A side is a group of players.

clue.text: Type of people having to deal with letter

definitions.text: Type of people having to deal with letter

parts.words: Type of people having to deal with letter
parts.note: a letter here is not mail but someone who lets out property, a landlord, so these are the folk who rent from one

explanation.surface: A kind of person who must handle correspondence.
explanation.definitionFit: Collectively, renters of land or houses form a body who answer to their landlord.

clue.text: Secure prime bit of your meat for the dog

parts.note: to seal is to secure

indicators.note: the prime, or first, bit of the word your is its opening letter

parts.note: ham is a cured meat

explanation.surface: Fasten the best part of your meat aside for the dog.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sealyham is a small white Welsh terrier breed.

clue.text: Looking ill, upset, carol is passing by

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means turned upside down, so the word reads from bottom to top

parts.note: pale means looking ill
to carol is to sing

explanation.surface: A sick, troubled carol singer goes by.
explanation.definitionFit: Time elapsing is time going past.

clue.text: Boundary partly on the leg side

definitions.text: Boundary partly on the leg side

parts.words: Boundary partly on the leg side
parts.note: sounds like cricket, where boundaries and the leg side are terms, but it means the lower edge of a skirt or dress, resting partly on the leg

explanation.surface: A cricket shot to the boundary on the leg side of the pitch.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the leg side is the half of the field behind the batter's legs and a boundary is a ball hit to the edge; neither is meant here.
explanation.definitionFit: The bottom edge of a garment marks where the fabric stops on the wearer's leg.

clue.text: Well-off guy with min. Culture but possibly Max. Sense

indicators.note: possibly signals one possible rearrangement of the letters

explanation.surface: A rich bloke with little culture but maximum common sense.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges MAXSENSE. ESSEX MAN is a British stereotype: a newly prosperous, brash voter from the county of Essex, east of London.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase labels an affluent but supposedly uncultured suburban type.

clue.text: Waits in the street, it being clearer than ever at night?

indicators.note: in means the waiting word sits inside the street abbreviation

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street
tarries means waits or lingers

explanation.surface: Someone loiters outside on the clearest of starry nights.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Waits' suggests carol singers in the street, but it is a plain verb, TARRIES.
explanation.definitionFit: A night sky with the most stars visible is the clearest.

clue.text: Bouncer employed at court

parts.note: suggests a doorman at a law court, but the bouncer is something that bounces on a playing court

explanation.surface: A doorman working at the courthouse.
explanation.definitionFit: The felt-covered sphere bounces on a court during a game of lawn sports.

clue.text: Avoid risk of sunburn and stay calm

definitions.meaning: literally, not stripping off the top in the sun
an idiom meaning not to lose your temper

explanation.surface: Advice for a hot day: cover up and don't get worked up.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally a shirt worn protects the skin; idiomatically the phrase urges patience and composure.

clue.text: Ruddy painful?

definitions.meaning: sore and swollen, as an injury

explanation.surface: Bloody sore, is it?
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both reddened and swollen with soreness.

clue.text: Verbally attacked restriction in toto

indicators.note: in means the restriction sits within the word toto

parts.note: taken as written
a rein is a restraint or restriction

explanation.surface: Someone was criticised over a complete ban.
explanation.definitionFit: To lay into someone is to criticise them fiercely.

clue.text: One who mends material needed by aviator

parts.note: rep is a ribbed fabric
an airman is an aviator

explanation.surface: A tailor needs cloth delivered by a pilot.
explanation.definitionFit: A mechanic or fixer restores broken items to working order.

clue.text: Choose man, as you might, say for easy task

indicators.note: as you might say marks the words as spoken rather than spelt

parts.note: pick means choose and Nick is a man's name

explanation.surface: Selecting a fellow, so to speak, is no trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: A picnic is idiomatically something very easy.

clue.text: I? I love to eat!

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O
dine means to eat

explanation.surface: A glutton's cry: I love my food!
explanation.definitionFit: I is the chemical symbol for this element.

clue.text: Good passages for ships

parts.note: alleys are narrow passages

explanation.surface: Fine channels for vessels to pass through.
explanation.definitionFit: Galleys were long oared vessels of the ancient and medieval world.

clue.text: The sixties maybe — not without love and hedonistic?

parts.note: the sixties is an example of a ten-year period

indicators.note: without means the zero letter is removed from the word not

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: Was the swinging sixties really so self-indulgent?
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe a self-indulgent life devoted to pleasure.

clue.text: This legal transaction is reversible

indicators.note: is reversible says the word reads the same backwards as forwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A legal agreement that can be undone.
explanation.definitionFit: A deed is a signed legal document conveying property or rights.

clue.text: Someone who rents won't want an outdoor shelter

indicators.note: won't want means those letters are taken out

parts.note: a tenant is someone who rents

explanation.surface: A renter has no wish for a camping canopy.
explanation.definitionFit: A tent is a portable canvas shelter used outdoors.

clue.text: For example, fellow without love, one with a ridiculous self-regard

indicators.note: without here means outside, so the zero stands just in front of the fellow

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O
a man is a fellow
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A loveless chap and his absurdly inflated opinion of himself.
explanation.definitionFit: Egomania is an obsessive, exaggerated preoccupation with oneself.

clue.text: Frail pet cried out

indicators.note: out signals the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A weak animal whimpered.
explanation.definitionFit: Decrepit means worn out and feeble with age.

clue.text: Humorous daughter has curl

parts.note: a roll is a curl, as of hair

explanation.surface: A funny girl with ringlets.
explanation.definitionFit: Droll means dryly amusing or comical.
